description:
Found while building fz-3ul.2 (fixture 00731), reproduced on 5371db0a0 without any try. Native codegen (JIT run and AOT build) panics with 'known scalar kind does not match requested raw ABI repr' at src/compiler2/native_codegen/fn_ctx.rs:443 when a call whose result is delivered as a raw int joins a branch whose other arm is a different kind:

def f(x) do
  a = if x do :ok else 10 + 10 end
  dbg(a)
end
def main() do
  f(true)
  f(false)
end

The interpreter prints :ok then 20. The same panic appears with case in place of if, and with a rescue arm ending in 10 + 10 when the try body returns an atom. The fixture 00731 was rewritten to avoid the shape ({:got, n} tuples) and must be restored to the direct form when this is fixed.

Acceptance: the program above runs on interp, run and build with the same output; fixture 00731 restored to arms that return bare ints and atoms; a native codegen unit test in the sibling _test.rs for the join repr decision; no numeric pin rises without explanation; gate green.
title: A call returning a raw int can join a branch of another kind
